ops.text: More recently, the 0.6-5 $\mu$m JWST transmission spectrum of the temperate sub-Neptune TOI-8264 b, which orbits an active K5 dwarf, showed no evidence for unocculted spots and was interpreted as an atmosphere enriched to about 62 times the solar metallicity (Vachon et al., 2026).

new_bib.text: A. Vachon, R. Gingras, N. Pouliot, M. Lapointe, F. Thériault, and O. Paquette (2026). A moderately metal-enriched envelope on the temperate sub-Neptune TOI-8264 b from JWST NIRISS/SOSS and NIRSpec/G395H transmission spectroscopy. arXiv e-prints.
